primary_reason: One row per engagement: the first snapshot on which the listed final date is within 7 days. That is the moment a near-term end becomes visible, without a stack of later days from the same run.

tree.rules:
|--- days_since_opening <= -2.50
|   |--- days_since_opening <= -4.50
|   |   |--- screenings_final_3_days <= 1.50
|   |   |   |--- class: 0
|   |   |--- screenings_final_3_days >  1.50
|   |   |   |--- class: 0
|   |--- days_since_opening >  -4.50
|   |   |--- incoming_friday_screenings <= 29.00
|   |   |   |--- class: 0
|   |   |--- incoming_friday_screenings >  29.00
|   |   |   |--- class: 0
|--- days_since_opening >  -2.50
|   |--- left_truncated <= 0.50
|   |   |--- market_theater_count <= 2.50
|   |   |   |--- class: 1
|   |   |--- market_theater_count >  2.50
|   |   |   |--- class: 1
|   |--- left_truncated >  0.50
|   |   |--- new_films_on_friday <= 3.50
|   |   |   |--- class: 0
|   |   |--- new_films_on_friday >  3.50
|   |   |   |--- class: 0
